display.purpose: Borderless note titles on the editor canvas.

headline.purpose: Collection headings and prominent empty-state headings.

title.purpose: Dense note-row titles and compact high-information labels.

label.purpose: Sparse uppercase section labels within the library rail.

shadows.name: ambient-surface
shadows.purpose: Available for light-theme lifted surfaces; resolves to none in dark mode.

shadows.name: ember-action
shadows.purpose: Soft lift for the circular create-note action.

shadows.name: transient-menu
shadows.purpose: Structural lift for the note action menu.

shadows.name: overlay-toast
shadows.purpose: Temporary overlay depth for toast feedback.

motion.name: save-rule-expand
motion.purpose: Extends the save rule while a note is being written to disk.

motion.name: save-color-shift
motion.purpose: Moves the save rule between neutral and ember states.

motion.name: saved-pulse
motion.purpose: Contracts the ember save confirmation to its neutral baseline after success.

motion.name: toast-transition
motion.purpose: Fades and lifts transient toast feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes visible transition and save-pulse motion when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: New Note Button
components.description: The sole circular primary action creates a fresh note.
components.html: <button class="ds-new-note" type="button" aria-label="Create a new note"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-new-note { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ember, #df5b42); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(223, 91, 66, 0.24); cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-new-note svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-new-note:hover { background: #c94d37; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-new-note:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e27560); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-new-note:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Library Navigation Item
components.description: A full-width charcoal-rail destination with a slim ember active marker.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--rail-muted, #b9bbb4); font: 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item kbd { margin-left: auto; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--rail-subtle, #a1a39c); font: 11px/1 inherit; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--rail-raised, #30312e); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--ember, #df5b42); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e27560); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A low-contrast paper search control that becomes explicit only on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6"/><path d="m15 15 4.5 4.5"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search your notes"><kbd>Ctrl F</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 37px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #ded9cf); border-radius: 7px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #fbfaf7) 72%, transparent); color: var(--faint, #69655d); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--focus, #e27560); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus, #e27560) 14%, transparent); } .ds-search svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #282721); font: 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #69655d); } .ds-search kbd { color: var(--faint, #69655d); font: 9px/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Note Row
components.description: A flat, ruled list item with an editorial excerpt and ember selection marker.
components.css: .ds-note-row { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; padding: 15px 12px 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #ded9cf); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #282721); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-note-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #fbfaf7) 55%, transparent); } .ds-note-row.is-selected { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #fbfaf7) 40%, transparent); } .ds-note-row.is-selected::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 14px; bottom: 14px; left: 0; width: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ember, #df5b42); } .ds-note-title { display: block; font: 650 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-note-excerpt { display: -webkit-box; margin: 7px 0 11px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted, #5f5c55); font: 12px/1.45 Georgia, serif; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; } .ds-note-meta { display: flex; gap: 7px; color: var(--faint, #69655d); font: 9px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-note-tag { color: var(--ember-text, #ad3b29); } .ds-note-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e27560); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toolbar Icon Button
components.description: A quiet square tool control that picks up ember only when relevant.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Toggle Markdown preview"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 12s3.5-5 9-5 9 5 9 5-3.5 5-9 5-9-5-9-5z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5f5c55); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.65; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-icon-button:hover, .ds-icon-button.is-active { background: var(--ember-soft, #f4d7cf); color: var(--ember, #df5b42); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e27560); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon-button:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ember-soft, #f4d7cf) 78%, var(--ember, #df5b42)); }

components.name: Empty State Action
components.description: A compact outlined action used when the editor has no selected note.
components.css: .ds-empty-action { padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ember, #df5b42); border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ember, #df5b42); font: 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-empty-action:hover { background: var(--ember-soft, #f4d7cf); } .ds-empty-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e27560); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-empty-action:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ember-soft, #f4d7cf) 75%, var(--ember, #df5b42)); }

components.name: Action Menu
components.description: A compact lifted menu for archive, trash, and restore actions.
components.css: .ds-action-menu { width: 176px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #ded9cf); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--canvas, #fbfaf7); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(31, 29, 24, 0.16); } .ds-action-menu button { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #282721); font: 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-action-menu button:hover { background: var(--paper, #f1eee7); } .ds-action-menu button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e27560); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-action-menu button:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper, #f1eee7) 75%, var(--rule, #ded9cf)); } .ds-action-menu .ds-danger { color: #be4a39; }

components.name: Save Feedback
components.description: The signature status line expands while saving, then contracts from ember to a neutral rule after success.
components.css: .ds-save-feedback { min-width: 95px; } .ds-save-status { position: relative; display: inline-flex; margin: 0; padding-bottom: 5px; color: var(--faint, #69655d); font: 10px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-save-status::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 14px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--rule, #ded9cf); transition: width 320ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-save-status.is-saving::after { width: 100%; } .ds-save-status.is-saved-pulse::after { animation: ds-saved-pulse 420ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-saved-pulse { 0% { width: 100%; background: var(--ember, #df5b42); } 100% { width: 14px; background: var(--rule, #ded9cf); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-save-status::after { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } .ds-save-status.is-saved-pulse::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Ember Notes feels like moving from a charcoal bookcase to a stack of warm index sheets and finally to a bright page under a focused lamp. It is a quiet operating interface: familiar navigation and controls carry the work, while material contrast, restrained typography, and rare ember cues make the system feel authored.

The rail is dense and recessive, the note list is warmer and more tactile, and the editor is the brightest, calmest surface. The writing surface uses serif type for long-form focus; interface controls remain compact sans-serif. Color is functional rather than decorative, and the save confirmation is the one signature motion.
keyCharacteristics: Three contiguous panes with distinct material roles: charcoal rail, warm paper list, bright editorial canvas.
Ink-led typography with serif writing surfaces and compact sans-serif interface chrome.
Ember reserved for selection, focus, tags, active tools, and save confirmation.
Separators and tonal shifts establish structure; floating cards do not.
Responsive one-pane navigation below 680px, with explicit library/list/editor movement.

rules.name: The Ember Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Ember marks an action, selection, focus target, authored tag, or completed save; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Three Materials Rule
rules.body: Keep the rail, list, and editor visibly distinct through charcoal, warm paper, and bright canvas surfaces.

rules.name: The Page Owns the Serif Rule
rules.body: Use serif type for authored content, document titles, previews, and literary empty states; navigation, metadata, and controls remain sans-serif.

rules.name: The Pane Continuity Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with rules and surface shifts, never with a dashboard of detached cards.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Transient Rule
rules.body: Resting panes and note rows stay flat; depth appears only for actions, menus, overlays, and the paper metaphor.

rules.name: The Quiet Corners Rule
rules.body: Keep the small-radius vocabulary; do not turn the interface into a field of pills or oversized rounded cards.

dos: Do preserve the charcoal rail, warm-paper list, and bright editorial canvas as three adjacent materials.
Do reserve ember for interactive state, selection, tags, focus, and confirmed save feedback.
Do keep authored writing and preview content in the editorial serif while interface chrome remains compact sans-serif.
Do use the 900px rail-collapse breakpoint and the 680px one-pane library/list/editor transition.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and disable the save pulse when reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't replace the pane structure with floating cards, glass panels, gradients, or decorative shadows.
Don't spread ember across passive backgrounds or ornamental surfaces; its rarity carries meaning.
Don't use pill-shaped navigation, oversized radii, uppercase eyebrow copy, or decorative monospace.
Don't introduce a second icon style or reduce compact-screen touch targets below 44px.
Don't animate routine writing interactions; the sub-500ms save line is the signature motion.
